about_the_game:
Hyperborea: Hornysolation is a sexy dystopia VN set in an alternate 2020 Hyperborea paralyzed by the “Lizard Flu” pandemic. The news screams one thing: reptilians are to blame. They’re rounded up, herded into reservations, and shipped off to colonize Mars.

You’re just another quarantined citizen—mask on your face, exit permit in hand, boredom driving you mad. Until you find a capsule hidden in your apartment wall… containing a live lizard girl. Tiny, kinda fluffy (well, almost), and absolutely unwilling to go to the Red Planet.

You hide her. And then things spiral gloriously out of control:
💚 A steamy romance with your lizard girl,
💚 A passionate fling with your hallway neighbor,
💚 A “bonus” delivery from a demoness food courier,
💚 And even the secret service commissioner—who clearly knows more than she lets on…

But the deeper you dive into these tangled affairs, the clearer it becomes: the pandemic is a hoax. It’s all part of a massive conspiracy. Now you must balance paranoia and pillow talk while deciding: betray your lizard girl to the authorities for your own safety—or become the last hope of an oppressed species?

Choose your lovers, uncover secrets, and never forget to wear your mask—even in bed.

Hornysolation: where love saves the world, and sex is the ultimate weapon against the system.
